shortDescription: Create or delete an event in oVirt/RHV

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary with values needed to create HTTP/HTTPS connection to oVirt:

options.name: cluster
options.description: The id of the cluster associated with this event.

options.name: correlation_id
options.description: The event correlation identifier. If not specified, the 'correlation-id' in the connection header will be used. If neither are available, it is not set.

options.name: custom_id
options.description: Custom ID for the event. This ID must be unique for each event. Required when state is present.

options.name: data_center
options.description: The id of the data center associated with this event.

options.name: description
options.description: Message for the event. Required when state is present.

options.name: fetch_nested
options.description: If I(True) the module will fetch additional data from the API. It will fetch IDs of the VMs disks, snapshots, etc. User can configure to fetch other attributes of the nested entities by specifying C(nested_attributes).

options.name: host
options.description: The id of the host associated with this event.

options.name: id
options.description: The event ID in the oVirt/RHV audit_log table. This ID is not the same as custom_id and is only used when state is absent. Required when state is absent.

options.name: nested_attributes
options.description: Specifies list of the attributes which should be fetched from the API. This parameter apply only when C(fetch_nested) is I(true).

options.name: origin
options.description: Originator of the event. Required when state is present.

options.name: poll_interval
options.description: Number of the seconds the module waits until another poll request on entity status is sent.

options.name: severity
options.description: Severity of the event. Required when state is present.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the event be present/absent. The C(wait) option must be set to false when state is absent.

options.name: storage_domain
options.description: The id of the storage domain associated with this event.

options.name: template
options.description: The id of the template associated with this event.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds the module should wait for the instance to get into desired state.

options.name: user
options.description: The id of the user associated with this event.

options.name: vm
options.description: The id of the VM associated with this event.

options.name: wait
options.description: C(yes) if the module should wait for the entity to get into desired state.
